weather.tip: Rain is very likely today (94% chance) with a high of 28.7°C — carry an umbrella and build in extra commute time, especially on already-congested stretches like Varthur-Sarjapur.

around.headline: At least five killed in a spate of road accidents around Bengaluru since Friday night
around.summary: Four died when a car crashed into a culvert on the Hyderabad-Bengaluru highway, and a woman was killed after her car flew off the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway, part of a run of accidents since Friday night, per NDTV, Star of Mysore and The New Indian Express. If you're on a highway at night and feel drowsy, pull over rather than pushing on.
around.source: NDTV, Star of Mysore, The New Indian Express

around.headline: Purple Line extension nears debut amid a renaming push and early queue complaints
around.summary: Ahead of the new Purple Line stretch opening, residents are pushing to rename the IIMB and Tavarekere stations, and commuters already report long queues at security checks, per The Times of India and The Siasat Daily. Separately, BMTC's revamped Namma BMTC 2.0 app is now live on iPhones after being Android-only, per The Hindu.
around.source: The Times of India, The Siasat Daily, The Hindu

around.headline: GBA cuts building-plan approval to 30 minutes, even as a new 'software charge' on tax bills draws flak
around.summary: The Greater Bengaluru Authority's new Nambike Nakshe 2.0 portal automates building-plan sanctions that used to take up to three months, per Deccan Herald and The Hindu — but the same civic body is being criticised for quietly adding an IT 'software charge' onto property tax bills, per TOI Bengaluru. Property owners should check their latest tax bill for the new line item.
around.source: Deccan Herald, The Hindu, TOI Bengaluru

around.headline: Tout paid ₹11 lakh for fake IAS-officer flight tickets, in a week of corruption cases
around.summary: A probe found a tout was paid ₹11 lakh to arrange 23 flight tickets for an IAS officer and a companion, per TOI Bengaluru — coming days after a Central GST Superintendent was filmed in Bengaluru accepting a separate ₹8 lakh bribe. A bribe demand at a government office can be reported directly to the Lokayukta helpline rather than paid.

around.headline: UPI merchant charges may return — but splitting a bill to dodge them won't work
around.summary: A merchant discount rate (MDR) on larger UPI payments is reportedly on the way, and splitting a ₹6,000 bill into three ₹2,000 payments won't get around it once it's in force, per TOI Bengaluru. For now, no MDR is actually being charged, so no action is needed yet.

around.headline: US extends its $100,000 fee on new H-1B visa petitions
around.summary: The extended fee applies to new H-1B applications and is being closely watched by Bengaluru's IT sector, which sends large numbers of engineers to the US on this visa route, per The Indian Express. Employees eyeing an onsite transfer should expect employers to weigh the added cost before sponsoring new petitions.

street_smart.title: It's past midnight and you're driving back to Bengaluru alone on the Mysuru highway after a long day. Your eyelids keep drooping and you catch yourself drifting slightly out of your lane. The next well-lit fuel station is 15 minutes away. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Today's real reports: at least five people died in road accidents around Bengaluru since Friday night, including four killed when a car crashed into a culvert on the Hyderabad-Bengaluru highway and a woman killed after her car flew off the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway (NDTV, Star of Mysore, The New Indian Express). Drowsy/night highway driving hasn't been used as a street-smart scenario in the last three weeks.
street_smart.situation: There's no shoulder wide enough to stop safely right where you are, traffic is light, and the drive so far has felt manageable — it's tempting to just push through to the fuel station.

choices.text: Slow down, turn on hazard lights, and pull in at the very next safe, well-lit spot — even a roadside dhaba before the fuel station — to rest or swap drivers before continuing.
choices.feedback: Correct. Microsleep can hit in as little as 2-4 seconds, which is enough time to drift into a culvert, median or oncoming lane at highway speed. Any safe, lit stop that lets you actually rest or hand over the wheel is worth more than reaching a 'better' stop later.

choices.text: Keep driving carefully to the fuel station 15 minutes away, reasoning that you're still in control and it isn't much further.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. Fifteen minutes is more than enough time for a microsleep to happen, and the drift-and-crash pattern behind this weekend's highway deaths shows how little warning there can be between 'feeling okay' and losing control.

choices.text: Roll down the windows, turn the music up loud, and continue driving to stay alert.
choices.feedback: Risky. Noise and cold air can mask drowsiness for a few minutes, but they don't remove the underlying fatigue — your reaction time stays impaired even while you feel more 'awake', which is exactly when a microsleep can catch you off guard.

choices.text: Stop briefly on the highway shoulder itself to rest for a few minutes before carrying on.
choices.feedback: Risky. Highway shoulders on a national highway see fast-moving traffic at night, and a parked car there is a serious rear-end-collision risk — the same stretch of highway that's unsafe to drive drowsy on is also unsafe to stop on without full clearance off the carriageway.

takeaways: Treat heavy eyelids or lane drift as a hard stop signal on a night drive, not something to power through — microsleep can last just 2-4 seconds but is enough to cause a fatal crash at highway speed.
For a breakdown or accident on a national highway (like NH275, the Bengaluru-Mysuru route), the National Highways Helpline 1033 connects you to roadside assistance and emergency response.
On any night highway drive over 2-3 hours, plan a driver swap or a real rest stop in advance rather than deciding only once you're already fighting to stay awake.

quiz.question: The Greater Bengaluru Authority's new Nambike Nakshe 2.0 system cuts building-plan approval time from three months to how long?
quiz.why: The portal automates checking a building plan against bylaws, a process that previously needed manual scrutiny across multiple departments.

quiz.question: The US has extended its $100,000 fee on new petitions for which visa category, closely watched by Bengaluru's IT sector?
quiz.why: The H-1B is the main visa route Indian IT firms use to send engineers to work onsite in the US, so a higher petition cost can make employers more cautious about new sponsorships.

quiz.question: According to this week's reports, roughly how much was a tout paid to arrange 23 flight tickets for an IAS officer and a companion?
quiz.why: The case surfaced in the same week Lokayukta police separately filmed a Central GST Superintendent accepting an unrelated ₹8 lakh bribe in Bengaluru.

quiz.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution is often called its 'heart and soul' for letting citizens approach the Supreme Court directly to enforce their fundamental rights?
quiz.why: Article 32 lets the Supreme Court issue writs — like habeas corpus and mandamus — directly to enforce fundamental rights, a power Dr. B.R. Ambedkar described in exactly those terms.

quiz.question: Roughly how high above sea level does Bengaluru sit, part of why it's historically had a cooler climate than most Indian cities at its latitude?
quiz.why: That elevation on the Deccan Plateau is why the city traditionally needed little artificial cooling, though rising urban heat has been eroding that natural advantage in recent years.
